chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him), that he said:
Nothing enters the belly of the consumptive (sufferer of tuberculosis) that is more beneficial for him than rice bread.

key_terms.الْمَسْلُولِ: The consumptive; one suffering from consumption or tuberculosis
key_terms.جَوْفَ: The belly or interior of the body

ai.seo_question: What is the most beneficial food for tuberculosis according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) identifies rice bread (*khubz al-aruzz*) as the most beneficial sustenance for those suffering from consumption (tuberculosis), reflecting the integration of dietary therapy (*tibb*) within Shia hadith literature. This highlights the tradition's emphasis on practical, accessible remedies derived from the Prophet's household, where food is viewed not merely as nourishment but as a means of healing and spiritual well-being.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, form Yunus, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There does not enter the inside of the (sufferer of) tuberculosis, anything more beneficial for him than the rice bread’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Nothing more useful enters the stomach of one suffering from Tuberculosis than bread of rice.’”
